_explanation.purpose: Domain model template - defines structure for domain concepts within story graph
_explanation.domain_placement: domain_concepts: 'local' if relevant to single sub_epic, 'global' if relevant to multiple sub_epics. Place at most specific level (local preferred), but elevate to parent if used by multiple children.
_explanation.usage: This template is for ADDING/UPDATING domain_concepts in existing story-graph.json. Do NOT modify story structure (epics, sub_epics, stories). Only add or update domain_concepts arrays.
